밖.t: Pronounced [바께] in 밖에: the ㄲ batchim carries over to the next syllable.

있다.forms: 있어요 · 있었어요 · 있을 거예요 · 있는 (+noun) · honorific: 계세요 (be somewhere), 있으세요 (have)
있다.m: to be (somewhere), to exist; to have
있다.e: 맛있다 = tasty (lit. 'flavor exists'); 재미있다 = fun. Opposite: 없다.
있다.t: Possession uses 이/가: 시간이 있어요 = I have time. Modifier is 있는, not 있은.
rel: to not exist, to not have

초대하다.x: I invited my friends to my birthday party.

온도.ex: 방 온도가 너무 높아서 창문을 열었어요.
온도.x: The room was too warm, so I opened the window.

불다.forms: 불어요 · 불었어요 · 불 거예요 · 부세요 (ㄹ drops)
불다.x: The wind is blowing hard today, so it's cold.
불다.e: Covers both wind blowing and you blowing: 촛불을 불다 'to blow out candles'.

현관.ex: 집에 들어올 때 신발은 현관에서 벗어 주세요.
현관.x: Please take off your shoes in the entryway when you come in.
현관.e: Originally a Buddhist temple term for a gate; the syllables don't help, so learn it whole.
현관.t: Koreans take off their shoes in the 현관 before stepping up into the house.

사과하다.x: I was late for class, so I apologized to the teacher first.
사과하다.e: Literally 'apologize for a fault' + 하다 'to do'.
사과하다.t: Mark the person with 에게 or 한테 (께 for elders): 친구에게 사과하다.

분실하다.x: If you lose your card, report it to the bank right away.
분실하다.e: Literally 'let it scatter and lose it'.
분실하다.t: More formal than 잃어버리다; you'll see it on official notices, forms and in banks.

현대.m: modern times, the present day; modern
현대.x: In modern society, a smartphone is a must.

결과.ex: 시험 결과는 다음 주 월요일에 나와요.
결과.x: The test results come out next Monday.

차별.x: Discrimination based on gender should disappear.
차별.t: 차별 is unfair treatment; for a neutral 'difference,' use 차이.

소문.x: I heard that restaurant is good.

일단.forms: 일단 + action (first, for now): 일단 먹자; 일단 -(으)면 (once ...)
일단.m: first, for now, for the moment; once
일단.x: I'm hungry, so let's eat first and then talk.
일단.e: Hanja reads 'one morning'; in use it means 'first of all' or 'once'.
일단.t: Very common in speech to propose a first step: 일단 가 보자 'Let's just go and see.'

전혀.forms: 전혀 + negative: 전혀 몰라요, 전혀 안 아파요
전혀.x: I don't know that person at all.
전혀.e: From 'whole': wholly, used to mean 'not at all' with negatives.
전혀.t: Always pair 전혀 with a negative like 안, 못, 없다, or 모르다.

골프.x: My dad plays golf with his friends on weekends.
골프.e: From English 'golf'; the final f becomes an extra syllable, 프.
골프.t: Use 치다 with golf, just like tennis: 골프를 치다.

우주.ex: 언젠가 우주로 여행을 가 보고 싶어요.
우주.x: Someday I'd like to travel to space.
우주.e: Classically 'all of space and all of time' together.

제안.ex: 친구가 주말에 같이 여행을 가자고 제안했어요.
제안.x: My friend suggested that we take a trip together this weekend.

최초.ex: 이곳은 이 도시에서 최초로 생긴 호텔이에요.
최초.x: This is the first hotel ever built in this city.
최초.t: 최초 is formal and often used as 최초의 N or 최초로; in daily talk, use 처음.

벌어지다.m: to happen, break out (an event); to open up, widen (a gap)
벌어지다.ex: 어젯밤 가게 앞에서 큰 싸움이 벌어졌어요.
벌어지다.x: A big fight broke out in front of the store last night.
벌어지다.e: Related to 벌리다 'to open wide' — picture a scene unfolding or a gap opening.

표절.ex: 남의 글을 그대로 베끼는 것은 표절이에요.
표절.x: Copying someone else's writing word for word is plagiarism.
표절.e: Literally 'rob and steal': taking someone's work as your own.

노화.x: UV rays are a major cause of skin aging.

탈춤.ex: 안동에 가면 하회 탈춤을 꼭 보세요.
탈춤.x: If you go to Andong, be sure to see the Hahoe mask dance.
탈춤.e: 탈 'mask' plus 춤 'dance'; performances often satirized nobles.
탈춤.t: Don't confuse 탈 'mask' with 탈 'trouble, illness' as in 배탈.

쾌활하다.x: She always greets people with a cheerful smile.

끊임없이.x: To succeed, you have to keep working hard without stopping.
끊임없이.e: 끊임 'a break' (from 끊다 'to cut') + 없이 'without': 'without a break'.
끊임없이.t: Pronounced [끄니멉씨]; ㄶ drops its ㅎ before a vowel.

뒤따르다.forms: 뒤따라요 · 뒤따랐어요 · 뒤따를 거예요 · 뒤따르세요 (ㅡ drops)
뒤따르다.m: to follow (behind); to come with, to accompany
뒤따르다.x: The children followed the teacher into the classroom.

품다.m: to hold in one's arms, embrace; to harbor (a feeling, dream, doubt)
품다.ex: 그는 어릴 때부터 가수의 꿈을 품었어요.
품다.x: He has dreamed of being a singer since he was young.
품다.e: From 품 'bosom, arms': holding something close to your chest.

연날리기.x: On Lunar New Year I flew kites with the kids in the park.
연날리기.t: A classic Lunar New Year folk game. The traditional rectangular kite (방패연) has a round hole in the middle.

은-는커녕.forms: 은커녕 after a consonant (밥은커녕) · 는커녕 after a vowel (커피는커녕) · + 도/조차 + negative
은-는커녕.m: let alone, far from (… not even)
은-는커녕.x: I was so busy I couldn't even drink water, let alone eat.
은-는커녕.e: 은/는 (topic) + 커녕 'far from it': 'as for X — forget it'.
은-는커녕.t: The second half usually has 도/조차 + a negative, or 만 for an unwanted result: 칭찬은커녕 잔소리만 들었어요 'Far from being praised, I just got nagged.'

관료.t: Pronounced [괄료] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

출마.ex: 그는 서울 시장 선거에 출마하기로 했습니다.
출마.x: He decided to run for mayor of Seoul.
출마.e: Literally 'going out on horseback', like a general riding into battle.
출마.t: Pattern: N에 출마하다 = to run in or for N.

화자.ex: 이 시의 화자는 떠난 사람을 그리워하고 있어요.
화자.x: The speaker of this poem is longing for someone who has left.

조치하다.m: to take measures, to take action
조치하다.ex: 학교는 사고를 막기 위해 즉시 조치했습니다.
조치하다.x: The school took immediate action to prevent accidents.

자인하다.m: to admit oneself, to confess, to own up to
자인하다.x: He admitted that he had failed.

깎아내리다.m: to belittle, to disparage, to run down
깎아내리다.ex: 남의 노력을 깎아내리는 말은 하지 마세요.
깎아내리다.x: Don't say things that belittle other people's efforts.
깎아내리다.e: 깎다 'to shave, cut' + 내리다 'to lower': shaving down someone's worth.
깎아내리다.t: Its opposite is 치켜세우다 'to praise to the skies' — one lowers, the other raises.

요긴하다.ex: 여행 갈 때 이 가방이 정말 요긴했어요.
요긴하다.x: This bag was really handy when I traveled.
요긴하다.e: Literally 'needed and urgent'; today it mostly means 'handy'.
요긴하다.t: Common in everyday talk: 요긴하게 쓰다 'to put to good use'.

한없이.ex: 아이의 웃는 얼굴을 보니 한없이 행복했어요.
한없이.x: Seeing my child's smiling face made me endlessly happy.
한없이.t: Pronounced [하넙씨]: the ㄴ links over and ㅅ becomes tense.

호시탐탐.m: watching for a chance, like a tiger eyeing its prey
호시탐탐.ex: 경쟁사가 우리 시장을 호시탐탐 노리고 있어요.
호시탐탐.x: Our competitors are eyeing our market, waiting for their chance.
호시탐탐.t: Used like an adverb, almost always with 노리다: 호시탐탐 노리다.

환골탈태.m: a complete transformation, a total makeover
환골탈태.x: That store was completely transformed after the remodel.
환골탈태.e: Literally 'swap the bones, replace the womb' — becoming a whole new being.

외화.ex: 여행을 떠나기 전에 원화를 외화로 바꿨어요.
외화.x: Before leaving on my trip, I exchanged won for foreign currency.
외화.e: Literally 'outside money'. Homonym 외화 can also mean a foreign film.

귀촌.m: moving to the countryside, rural relocation (from the city)
귀촌.ex: 은퇴 후에 귀촌을 선택하는 사람들이 늘고 있어요.
귀촌.x: More and more people are choosing to move to the countryside after retiring.
귀촌.t: 귀촌 is moving to rural life in general; 귀농 specifically means moving there to farm.

열연.ex: 주인공의 열연이 극장의 모든 관객들을 감동시켰어요.
열연.x: The lead actor's passionate performance moved everyone in the theater.
열연.t: Pronounced [여련]; often used as a verb: 열연하다, 'to give a passionate performance'.

거물.x: He is called a heavyweight of Korean politics.

테러리즘.ex: 세계 각국은 테러리즘에 맞서 협력하고 있습니다.
테러리즘.x: Countries around the world are cooperating against terrorism.
테러리즘.e: From English 'terrorism'; in everyday speech Koreans usually just say 테러.

환담.ex: 두 정상은 회담 전에 잠시 환담을 나눴습니다.
환담.x: The two leaders had a brief friendly chat before the talks.

동료평가.ex: 이 논문은 동료평가를 거쳐 학술지에 실렸습니다.
동료평가.x: This paper was published in a journal after going through peer review.
동료평가.t: Pronounced [동뇨평까] — nasalization makes 료 sound like [뇨].

아비규환.m: pandemonium, a hellish scene of chaos and screaming
아비규환.ex: 지진이 일어난 거리는 순식간에 아비규환이 되었습니다.
아비규환.x: The street hit by the earthquake instantly turned into a hellish scene.
아비규환.e: From Buddhism: the Avici hell and the screaming hell; the first two syllables just spell a Sanskrit name.

사주하다.m: to instigate, to put someone up to (a wrongdoing)
사주하다.ex: 경찰은 누가 범행을 사주했는지 조사하고 있습니다.
사주하다.x: The police are investigating who instigated the crime.
사주하다.e: Literally 'make someone do it by egging them on.'
사주하다.t: Homonym: 사주 (四柱) is fortune-telling by birth date; 사주 (社主) is a company owner.

질타하다.m: to rebuke, to castigate, to scold sharply
질타하다.x: The lawmakers castigated the minister's irresponsible attitude.
질타하다.e: Literally 'shout and scold' — both syllables mean to yell at.

암담하다.x: After my business failed, the future looked bleak.

혐오표현.ex: 온라인 혐오표현을 규제해야 한다는 목소리가 높습니다.
혐오표현.x: There are growing calls to regulate online hate speech.
혐오표현.e: Literally 'hatred expression'; the 오 here is the 'hate' reading of the character for 악 'evil'.

일소하다.m: to sweep away, to wipe out, to eradicate completely
일소하다.x: The new mayor promised to wipe out corruption.
일소하다.e: Literally 'one sweep' — clearing something away in a single stroke.
일소하다.t: Homonym warning: 일소 can also mean 'a laugh' as in 일소에 부치다 'to laugh off'.

스러지다.m: to vanish, to fade away, to die out
스러지다.ex: 해가 지자 붉은 노을이 천천히 스러졌어요.
스러지다.x: As the sun went down, the red glow slowly faded away.
스러지다.e: Sounds like 사라지다 'to disappear' and means something close, but more poetic.
스러지다.t: Don't confuse with 쓰러지다 'to collapse' — 스러지다 is softer, things melting quietly away.

환원주의.ex: 모든 행동을 유전자로 설명하는 것은 환원주의라는 비판을 받아요.
환원주의.x: Explaining all behavior by genes is criticized as reductionism.
환원주의.t: -주의 means '-ism' (민주주의, 자본주의) and is usually pronounced [주이].

대뇌.x: The cerebrum is in charge of thinking and remembering.
대뇌.e: Literally 'big brain': the largest part of the brain.
